usage: cox runs [-h]
                {usage,trace,clean,land,fetch,review,recover,series,wait,events,top,bar,notify,detail,stranded,cause,stop,pause,resume,move}
                ...

What a harness run recorded, and cleaning up after it.

positional arguments:
  {usage,trace,clean,land,fetch,review,recover,series,wait,events,top,bar,notify,detail,stranded,cause,stop,pause,resume,move}
    usage               usage stats and cost for one run
    trace               the tool-call trace for one run
    clean               delete a run's worktree and branches locally
    land                merge a run's branch into the target repo
    fetch               pull an ended remote lane's run directory, log and branches to this
                        machine
    review              review a contributor PR with the review graph and post the verdict
    recover             merge an approved task's commit into its phase branch after an escalated
                        merge
    series              per-run summary rows across a runs directory
    wait                block until a busy lane's run exits, then print its outcome lines
    events              poll a run's log for structured events
    top                 live table of busy lanes (runs in flight); --once prints it and exits
    bar                 one Waybar JSON line: busy lanes, cost, class idle|running|attention
    notify              desktop notifications for exits, quarantines, budget stops and cost
    detail              one run's timeline, objection and last tool calls
    stranded            every approved task record whose work item is not done, with its remedy
    cause               record why one run's attempt at a task was quarantined
    stop                stop a run's process, local or remote, and wait for it to exit
    pause               mark a run paused in the store
    resume              mark a paused run resumed in the store
    move                stop a run at its node boundary and relaunch it on another host

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

examples:
  cox runs fetch <run>
  cox runs land <run> --repo PATH --apply
  cox runs recover <run> <task> --repo PATH
  cox runs usage <run> --json
  cox runs detail <run> --json
